# O11y.one Provider

Manage O11y.one SLIs, SLOs, alert runbooks, contacts, notification groups, destinations, notification templates, policies, maintenance windows, silences, Observe alert definitions, and previews through the authenticated gRPC API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "o11y" {
  endpoint                = "https://grpc.o11y.one"
  connect_timeout_seconds = 10
  request_timeout_seconds = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `connect_timeout_seconds` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds. Defaults to 10.
- `endpoint` (String) O11y.one gRPC API origin, https://grpc.o11y.one. Defaults to O11Y_ENDPOINT.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Allow HTTP or skip TLS verification. Defaults to false.
- `org_id` (String) Organization UUID. Defaults to O11Y_ORG_ID.
- `request_timeout_seconds` (Number) Per-RPC timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID. Defaults to O11Y_TENANT_ID.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) O11y.one bearer token. Defaults to O11Y_TOKEN.
